title: ccwbalance: Artificial-Censoring Diagnostics for Clone-Censor-Weight Analyses
description: R package and reproduction code for risk-set reconstruction balance (RRB), zero-targeted diagnostics for artificial censoring in clone-censor-weight analyses of target trial emulation. The repository contains the package, the simulation and case-study scripts, the scenario definitions and the saved simulation outputs that reproduce the tables and figures of the accompanying manuscript.
